# telnyx_tunnel_rotate_token (Action)

Issues a new token for a tunnel and invalidates the previous one, for example after the token leaked. Terraform actions return no values, so the new token is not shown and the token in the tunnel's state stops working.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Revoke a leaked tunnel token: run with
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.telnyx_tunnel_rotate_token.lab
# The new token is not returned. Replace the tunnel to get a token in state.
action "telnyx_tunnel_rotate_token" "lab" {
  config {
    tunnel_id = telnyx_tunnel.lab.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tunnel_id` (String) The tunnel id.
